items.name: theme-moderno
items.title: Theme Moderno
items.description: The default Moderno brand: near-black monochrome workspace with sharp corners. Defines the contract slots in :root (light) and .dark (dark).

items.name: theme-contrast
items.title: Theme Contrast
items.description: Synthetic maximum-contrast brand scoped under [data-brand="contrast"], composed with .dark. Demonstrates the multi-brand switch.

items.name: button
items.title: Button (eject)
items.description: Ejected copy of the @moderno-ui/react Button primitive. Use only when you must own the markup; styling still comes from @moderno-ui/css.

items.name: login-form-react
items.title: Login Form (React)
items.description: Sign-in section composing the @moderno-ui/react Card, Field, Checkbox, Button and Alert primitives; responds to its container (@container) rather than the viewport, and renders its default, disabled, loading and error states from props.

items.name: form-layout-react
items.title: Form Layout (React)
items.description: Grouped settings form composing the @moderno-ui/react Field, Checkbox, Divider, Button and Alert primitives; responds to its container (@container) across all three contract steps — actions row at @sm, two-up field grid at @md, group headings beside their fields at @lg — and renders its default, disabled, loading and error states from props.

items.name: alert-list-react
items.title: Alert List (React)
items.description: Notification centre composing the @moderno-ui/react Alert, Button and Card primitives: a stack of dismissible status alerts in all four variants, with its own empty, loading and error renders and a heading it takes as a prop; responds to its container (@container) across all three contract steps — the header lines up at @sm, each dismiss control grows its label at @md, each timestamp moves to the trailing edge at @lg.

items.name: sign-in-react
items.title: Sign in (React)
items.description: Full-viewport sign-in screen composing the login-form and alert-list blocks: the credential form with its error, loading and disabled states, and the service notices a person needs before signing in. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container) across all three contract steps: the masthead lines up at @sm, the footer at @md, and the notices move beside the card at @lg.
